GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiTablePr class.

SetCellSpacing.description: Specifies the default table cell spacing (the spacing between adjacent cells and the edges of the table).

params.description: Spacing value measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch). `"Null"` means that no spacing will be applied.
params.name: nValue

SetJc.description: Specifies the alignment of the current table with respect to the text margins in the current section.

params.description: The alignment type used for the current table placement.
params.name: sJcType

SetShd.description: Specifies the shading which is applied to the extents of the current table.

params.description: The shading created with the Api.CreateShd method.
params.name: shd

SetStyleColBandSize.description: Specifies a number of columns which will comprise each table column band for this table style.

params.description: The number of columns measured in positive integers.
params.name: nCount

SetStyleRowBandSize.description: Specifies a number of rows which will comprise each table row band for this table style.

params.description: The number of rows measured in positive integers.
params.name: nCount

SetTableBorderAll.description: Specifies a border which will be displayed on all table cell borders.

params.description: The border style.
params.name: type

params.description: The width of the current border measured in eighths of a point.
params.name: size

params.description: The spacing offset in the table cells measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: space

params.description: The border color.
params.name: color

SetTableBorderAll.signature: SetTableBorderAll(type: BorderType, size: pt_8, space: pt, color: ApiColor): boolean

SetTableBorderBottom.description: Sets the border which will be displayed at the bottom of the current table.

params.description: The bottom border style.
params.name: type

params.description: The width of the current bottom border measured in eighths of a point.
params.name: size

params.description: The spacing offset in the bottom part of the table measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: space

params.description: The border color.
params.name: color

SetTableBorderBottom.signature: SetTableBorderBottom(type: BorderType, size: pt_8, space: pt, color: ApiColor): boolean

SetTableBorderInsideH.description:
Specifies the border which will be displayed on all horizontal table cell borders which are not on the outmost edge
of the parent table (all horizontal borders which are not the topmost or bottommost borders).

params.description: The horizontal table cell border style.
params.name: type

params.description: The width of the current border measured in eighths of a point.
params.name: size

params.description: The spacing offset in the horizontal table cells of the table measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: space

params.description: The border color.
params.name: color

SetTableBorderInsideH.signature: SetTableBorderInsideH(type: BorderType, size: pt_8, space: pt, color: ApiColor): boolean

SetTableBorderInsideV.description:
Specifies the border which will be displayed on all vertical table cell borders which are not on the outmost edge
of the parent table (all vertical borders which are not the leftmost or rightmost borders).

params.description: The vertical table cell border style.
params.name: type

params.description: The width of the current border measured in eighths of a point.
params.name: size

params.description: The spacing offset in the vertical table cells of the table measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: space

params.description: The border color.
params.name: color

SetTableBorderInsideV.signature: SetTableBorderInsideV(type: BorderType, size: pt_8, space: pt, color: ApiColor): boolean

SetTableBorderLeft.description: Sets the border which will be displayed on the left of the current table.

params.description: The left border style.
params.name: type

params.description: The width of the current left border measured in eighths of a point.
params.name: size

params.description: The spacing offset in the left part of the table measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: space

params.description: The border color.
params.name: color

SetTableBorderLeft.signature: SetTableBorderLeft(type: BorderType, size: pt_8, space: pt, color: ApiColor): boolean

SetTableBorderRight.description: Sets the border which will be displayed on the right of the current table.

params.description: The right border style.
params.name: type

params.description: The width of the current right border measured in eighths of a point.
params.name: size

params.description: The spacing offset in the right part of the table measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: space

params.description: The border color.

SetTableBorderRight.signature: SetTableBorderRight(type: BorderType, size: pt_8, space: pt, color: ApiColor): boolean

params.description: The spacing offset in the top part of the table measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: space

params.name: color

SetTableBorderTop.signature: SetTableBorderTop(type: BorderType, size: pt_8, space: pt, color: ApiColor): boolean

SetTableCellMarginBottom.description:
Specifies an amount of space which will be left between the bottom extent of the cell contents and the border
of all table cells within the parent table (or table row).

params.description: The value for the amount of space below the bottom extent of the cell measured intwentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nValue

SetTableCellMarginLeft.description:
Specifies an amount of space which will be left between the left extent of the cell contents and the left
border of all table cells within the parent table (or table row).

params.description: The value for the amount of space to the left extent of the cell measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nValue

SetTableCellMarginRight.description:
Specifies an amount of space which will be left between the right extent of the cell contents and the right
border of all table cells within the parent table (or table row).

params.description: The value for the amount of space to the right extent of the cell measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nValue

SetTableCellMarginTop.description:
Specifies an amount of space which will be left between the top extent of the cell contents and the top border
of all table cells within the parent table (or table row).

params.description: The value for the amount of space above the top extent of the cell measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nValue

params.description: The table description to be set.
params.name: sDescr

SetTableInd.description:
Specifies the indentation which will be added before the leading edge of the current table in the document
(the left edge in the left-to-right table, and the right edge in the right-to-left table).

params.description: The indentation value measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nValue

SetTableLayout.description: Specifies the algorithm which will be used to lay out the contents of the current table within the document.

params.description: The type of the table layout in the document.
params.name: sType

params.description: The table title to be set.
params.name: sTitle

SetWidth.description:
Sets the preferred width to the current table.

**Note:**
Tables are created with the {@link ApiTable#SetWidth} method properties set by default, which always override the {@link ApiTablePr#SetWidth} method properties. That is why there is no use to try and apply {@link ApiTablePr#SetWidth}. We recommend you to use the  {@link ApiTablePr#SetWidth} method instead.

params.description: Type of the width value from one of the available width values types.
params.name: sType

params.description: The table width value measured in positive integers.
params.name: nValue

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiTablePr object into the JSON object.
